notes.title: Games Forged in Germany & Demo Update
notes.notes:
We are delighted to be included in the Games Forged in Germany event on Steam until 31st July 2025. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/6dc72876c21618eff12fb6a984b22d245c3652b2.jpg[/img]

The event features many wonderful games from German developers and publishers and all the information about the event, the discounts and the demos included can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany

Check out our demo as part of the event. Our demo features 2 playable levels where you can learn the basics of leading your band of hapless craftlings to create a settlement on the strange island they find themselves stranded upon. You’ll learn about building, production chains, resource management in level 1 and progressing to combat and advanced settlement building in level 2. 

We love to see how you create and the ranks you obtain during the demo so feel free to share these with us on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/craftlingsgame]Discord[/url]. 

[h2]Demo Update[/h2]

Following feedback from the community we have made some updates, added new features and fixed some bugs in the demo today including: 
[list]
[*]Optimized level 1 design and balancing for tutorial needs / teaching purposes
[*]Optimized texts in English and updated translation for German and Polish
[*]Added new OST, including new Main Menu Loop
[*]Bug fixes and optimization for better gameplay flow
[/list]
We would love to hear your feedback about your experience with the demo. You can use the in-game link to let us know your thoughts. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/Craftlings/

notes.title: Demo Updates & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We’ve made some changes to the Craftlings demo.

We have added some new features, fixed some bugs and made a few updates. All of these are detailed in the patch notes below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/f8883e99ca88b923306de38a7828d23764a52bba.jpg[/img]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]New: Added Cargo lift below the workshop on level 1 
[*]New: Added a stone sign to level 1 to help with traffic control
[*]New: Craftlings can now change direction on ladders
[*]New: Craftlings carrying tools can now use ladders
[*]New: Added small animations to the tooltip/tutorial on appear and hide 
[*]New: Added green and yellow and wood log icons to some tutorial elements on level 1
[*]New: Added coin icon to tutorial about tool limitation on level 1
[*]New: Added tutorial steps for wood sign and stone sign
[*]Update: QoL - Ladders can now be clicked and highlighted if the mouse is over a ladder segment and not just  when it’s over the ladder widget
[*]Update: Increased the speed of the camera on tutorial appear and added small ease-in effect
[*]Update: Added outline to icons on ladder signs for better visibility
[*]Update: Highlighting a Craftling will not remove the building tooltip.
[*]Update: Added mouse icon at the end of the text for tutorial steps about selecting building and choosing building spot. 
[*]Update: Reduced falling distance.
[*]Update: The cargo lift tutorial has been moved to the object. It will now trigger when the cargo lift is used. 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where if the tutorial for "turn around" had been displayed and the player rushed the Town Hall, the hammer tutorial did not appear.
[*]Fixed an issue where the vegetable bed would restart if the player changed which vegetable was growing.
[*]Fixed so that grapes need only planks once and not after each harvest
[*]Fixed an issue where closing and reopening the vegetable bed with grapes selected would force you to deliver one more plank
[*]Fixed so that the tutorial for building spot triggers for other buildings on level 1 
[*]Fixed an issue where the skeleton tooltip was stuck on the screen
[/list]

Craftlings is coming to PC in 2025 so play our new demo and wishlist now.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/Craftlings/

notes.title: Polish Constitution Days Event & Demo Update
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that Craftlings is included in the Polish Constitution Days event on Steam now until 3rd May 2025! As the Craftlings development team at Ariano Games is 100% Polish it is a pleasure to be included in a celebration of Polish game development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/a9700edcf7a0310e1034c0220ba320e808c06642.png[/img]

Craftlings is all about leading your hapless settlers to build a civilization on the island where they have found themselves. You’ll need to be able to manage resources, place and build homes, shops and utilities to help you expand and survive. Do you have what it takes to lead your craftlings to success?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/724cddbb23aa964161055414c254ef938d96172b.jpg[/img]

We’ve also decided to leave the demo for Craftlings free to play on Steam for everyone to try indefinitely. We would love to hear about your experiences with the demo and how your civilization building efforts turned out. Let us know on our [url=https://x.com/Craftlingsgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/craftlingsgame.bsky.social]Bluesky [/url]or join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/craftlingsgame]Discord[/url].

Now go forth and build!
Craftlings is coming to PC in 2025. Play the Demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/Craftlings/

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (Now with Leaderboard Support!)
notes.notes:
Following feedback we've received from the community, we've made some updates to the Craftlings Demo, including adding leaderboards!:

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Camera Movement to RMB, adding new input system 
[*]Moved the buying functionality from the bottom bar to LMB 
[*]Added a ladder icon 
[*]Added size indicator to building widget
[*]Added translations for "size" to building widget
[*]Added steamworks API plugin for demo
[*]Added winter challenge leaderboard to demo
[*]Added time leader board to Octopus Level
[*]Added time leader board to Lighthouse Level
[*]Changed tutorial for buying to show that it works with both buttons (LMB)/(RMB)
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated tutorial to reflect changes in buying functionality
[*]New icons for pickaxe and hammer to better distinguish them 
[*]Corrected typos and grammatical errors in the game text

[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of Craftlings. The demo is available to play for free NOW.

notes.title: Octopus & The Traveler - Update
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that on August 3rd I will launch a big update for The Settlings Demo including new map, new mechanics and many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41281037/e23feeef0f9ba9bccd8c7f53a429826ea03cf74b.png[/img]

What's New:

[list]
[*] New Map with unlimited playtime - Forest Island
[*] New water Boss: Octopus!
[*] New Mechanic: Auto-shooting with Ballista for water Bosses
[*] New Building: Siege Workshop where you produce bolts for Ballista
[*] New Reward System on building placement
[*] New UI with instant buy from the bottom bar
[*] New Tutorial map: 10-minute experience for new players
[*] New Tooltip system for buildings, inventory & spells
[*] New 2-level house upgrade system
[/list]

Other changes:

[list]
[*] Old tutorials have been removed
[*] The old demo map has been moved to the challenge mode and remains the same
[*] Different starting conditions
[*] The game starts in fullscreen
[*] All critical and major bug fixes
[/list]

What is still missing:
A LOT!
Now, seriously: save system & celebration screen for finishing the lighthouse

About me and what's next:
As some of you may know, I am solo developing this game. It started as a hobby project back in Summer 2021, and for now, it is still a hobby project...
But I am trying to use all my skills and do my best to find a way to go full-time game dev and build a great, engaging, and fun game - on those foundations we build together!
Because without you, without your support, I wouldn't even have a chance to dream about an indie dev career!

So stay tuned, and I will try to update you more regularly about what is going on :)

Best,
Ariano
